Name: Animated Orbs for 1.6
Author: CozyPsychologist
Description:
A port of Vyranity's Animated Orbs mod, updated to work with Stardew Valley 1.6+. The original mod used Dynamic Game Assets, which is no longer functional in 1.6. This port converts all 18 orbs to use Content Patcher and SpaceCore, preserving the original animations and artwork.
Adds 11 animated and 7 static decorative orbs to the furniture catalogue. 

For all the witches, wizards, ghouls and goblins that want more magical aesthetic for their home (or wherever). 

[b]All credit goes to Vyranity for the original mod which can be found [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/13086]Here[/url][/b]

[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI
[*]Content Patcher
[*]SpaceCore
[/list]
